messages.author: d067fbd7b8a8f3fe
messages.subject: Linkage mapping with DH data
parts:
Hi, 


I am receiving warnings with my genotypic data and strange genotype patterns on 8O (markers that were not assigned to any chromosome).

         > TEyieldARL <- read.cross("csv", "E:/ARC/R/Mydata", "TEyieldARL.csv", estimate.map =                FALSE, na.strings = "-", sep = ";", genotypes = c("AA","AB","BB"), alleles = c("A", "B"),                     crosstype = "dh")
            --Read the following data:
         146  individuals
        3204  markers
              6  phenotypes
            --Cross type: dh 
          Warning messages:
                1: In summary.cross(cross) : Invalid genotypes. 
                    Observed genotypes: 1 3
                2: In summary.cross(cross) : Strange genotype pattern on chr 8O.
                3: In summary.cross(cross) :
                    Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with the genetic                          map.
                      (Perhaps it is in basepairs?).


I ignored the warnings and carried on to clean the data and I got a very worrying warning, where the genotype % was 100% for AA and 0 for BB.

               par(mfrow=c(1,2), las=1)
               > plot(ntyped(TEyieldARL), ylab="No. markers", xlab = "No. individuals", main ="No.                     genotypes by individual")
               > plot(ntyped(TEyieldARL, "mar"), ylab="No. individuals", xlab = "No. markers",                               main="No. genotypes by marker")
               > TEyieldARL <- subset(TEyieldARL, ind=(ntyped(TEyieldARL)>1602))
               > TEyieldARL
                   This is an object of class "cross".
                   It is too complex to print, so we provide just this summary.
                Doubled haploids

                No. individuals:    91 

                No. phenotypes:     6 
                Percent phenotyped: 100 75.8 75.8 75.8 75.8 75.8 

                No. chromosomes:    23 
                Autosomes:      1A 1B 1D 2A 2B 2D 3A 3B 3D 4A 
                        4B 4D 5A 5B 5D 6A 6B 6D 7A 7B 
                        7D Un 8O 

               Total markers:      3204 
               No. markers:        53 64 67 87 128 120 72 74 80 
                        59 30 22 51 87 58 48 63 57 110 
                        99 64 47 1664 
               Percent genotyped:  76.4 
               Genotypes (%):      AA:100.0  BB:0.0 
              Warning messages:
              1: In summary.cross(x) : Invalid genotypes. 
               Observed genotypes: 1 3

How do I fix this?

I have attached my genotypic data.

I am new to QTL mapping and using R. Any help will be much appreciated!

regards
Celesta

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Linkage mapping with DH data
parts:
This is not intuitive, but use genotypes=c(“AA”, “BB”) in the call to read.cross(). 

karl
